title: Bootstrapping sdkenv: Icebox sprint journal
body:
Purpose:

This is a compact sprint journal for the "Icebox" sdkenv: a minimal, low-friction SDK environment we want to trial across two internal teams (Console and Dedicated). The goal is to validate a micro-onboarding flow (sub-10-minute first call -> working sample app) and a tiny telemetry contract that surfaces the right signals for product/eng decisions without leaking PII or creating expensive storage retention needs.

Audience:
- Internal integrators (solutions engineers)
- SDK maintainers and docs writers
- Developer advocates running the pilot sessions

High-level objectives (Sprint outcomes):
1) First-call experience: a reproducible guide that gets an engineer from install to a streaming generation in <=10 minutes on their laptop.
2) Telemetry contract v0: 6 fields (sdk_version, route, model_variant, latency_ms_p50, error_bucket, sample_prompt_hash) emitted at 1-per-session with privacy rules.
3) Micro quickstart: single-file sample (node + python variants) + CI smoke test that runs in <60s in our CI.
4) Onboarding feedback loop: 3 pilot sessions and a feedback form; triage top 5 friction items.

Why "Icebox"?
- Tiny scope and intentionally opinionated defaults: small API surface, default timeouts, network-free local stub runner.
- Focused on speed-to-success rather than covering every edge-case.

Assumptions and guardrails:
- No heavy SDK features (no plugin system, no complex credential flows). Use API key env var to simplify for pilot.
- Telemetry must be opt-out at CLI flag level and opt-in for sample recording.
- Keep dependencies minimal (one transport, minimal devDependencies).
- Repo and artifacts kept internal until experimental sign-off.

Minimal API sketch (pseudo):

1) JS (index.js)
const {Client} = require('@redwood/icebox');
const c = new Client({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});
await c.generate({model: 'rw-small-1', prompt: 'Summarize: ...', stream: true});

2) Python (quick.py)
from redwood_icebox import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
c.generate(model='rw-small-1', prompt='Summarize: ...', stream=True)

Quickstart flow (10-minute script):
- Prereq: Node 18+ or Python 3.10+, API key in env.
- Step 0: git clone (tiny repo)
- Step 1: npm ci / pip install -r requirements.txt
- Step 2: node examples/streaming.js OR python examples/streaming.py
- Expected: stream of tokens printed to console in <10s, exit cleanly.

Telemetry contract (v0) - emit once per successful invocation:
- sdk_name: "icebox"
- sdk_version: "%VERSION%"
- model_variant: string (e.g., "rw-small-1-8q")
- route: simple enum ("generate", "embed", "chat")
- latency_ms_p50: integer
- error_bucket: "none" | "4xx" | "5xx" | "timeout"
- sample_prompt_hash: sha256(hex) truncated (8 chars) - irreversible, no plaintext stored
- Note: user identifiers excluded; link only by ephemeral session id for debugging when user opted-in.

CI smoke test plan:
- Use a hermetic mock endpoint in CI that responds with a tiny token stream.
- Test asserts: exit code 0, printed tokens > 0, telemetry event emitted to mock collector.
- Time budget: 60s per run.

Pilot plan and schedule (2-week rolling):
Week 1:
- Day 1: internal demo and install test with Console integrator team (observed onboarding).
- Day 2-3: iterate quickstart script after notes.
- Day 4: run CI smoke for both node and python variants.
- Day 5: run first telemetry ingest through mock pipeline, verify schema.

Week 2:
- Run 3 pilot sessions across cross-functional engineers (Console, Dedicated infra, DevRel).
- Collect feedback survey (5 questions, 3 forced-choice + 2 free text).
- Identify top 5 friction items and label tickets.
- Ship a patch to docs and the example repo.

Observation checklist (for pilot facilitators):
- Time to first token (seconds)
- Number of commands typed/copy-paste steps
- Fail points observed: install error, missing env var, dependency mismatch, network policy blocked
- Clarity of error messages (rate 1-5)
- Whether user toggled telemetry opt-in flow

Open design questions (needs triage):
1) Telemetry retention window: 7 days vs 30 days? (prod needs differ; start with 7d for pilot)
2) Should the sample_prompt_hash be salted per-org to avoid cross-org collisions? (ops/infra input)
3) Local stubbed runner: what binaries do we allow bundled vs requiring docker?
4) Default model_variant: pick smallest latency model that still returns coherent text - initial candidate: rw-small-1-8q

Edge-case notes:
- Airgapped users: Icebox should have an offline-only mode that uses a local stub present in the repo; telemetry disabled.
- CI flakiness: make the CI smoke tolerant of small timing jitter; use retries with backoff.

Docs & collateral we need to write:
- README.md: one-page quickstart (target <= 300 words)
- examples/: node, python, shell script examples
- telemetry-spec.md: plain English contract and privacy notes
- facilitator-playbook.md: step-by-step instructions for pilot leads
- issue templates: onboarding-friction.md, api-surface-question.md

Quick copy for README (candidate):
Icebox sdkenv — 10-minute onramp to Redwood inference\n1) git clone ...
2) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx
3) npm ci && node examples/streaming.js
4) watch tokens stream, press ctrl-c to stop

Feedback capture (survey sample):
- How long did it take to see first token? <5m / 5-10m / >10m
- Was any step unclear? (yes/no) + short comment
- Did you opt into telemetry for the session? (yes/no)
- Which OS did you use? (mac/linux/win)
- Anything else? (free text)

Next steps after pilot (success criteria):
- >= 80% of pilot participants see first token within 10 minutes
- No major install blockers (<=2 unique blocker tickets)
- Telemetry events successfully received and mapped to dashboard fields
- Create follow-up plan for "Icebox v1" to support one extra feature: local caching or function-calling sample

Notes to self (TODO):
- Draft README and examples this week (Asha)
- Open GH repo and protect default branch (Miguel)
- Get infra mock collector endpoint (Evan)
- Wire a quick Grafana/Looker dashboard for p50 latency by route (product metric sketch)

Quick links for triage:
- Existing onboarding notes: confluence://redwood/SDK-Onboard-Playbook (reference)
- Related GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdkenv/issues/300 (dependency crosswalk)

Raw pilot facilitator script (for copy/paste):
1) "Hi — clone this repo. We'll put an API key into your env variable and run a single script that streams tokens to your terminal. Watch for an opt-in prompt for telemetry. Ready?"
2) Run through steps; observe and narrate.
3) If stuck, ask them to paste error output into the shared Slack thread #sdkenv-icebox and tag @devexp.

End of journal entry.

Revision history:
- 2025-01-12: initial draft and goals (Asha)
- 2025-01-20: telemetry contract sketched, added CI plan (Miguel)
- 2025-02-02: pilot schedule refined, facilitator script added (Lena)
